The '''Butcher of Bannakon''' was an infamous wanted criminal. Police on [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] had in their custody a man they claimed was the Butcher, but who claimed to be an innocent hunter. His claim proved true and the man was released by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Bearer of Darkness}}</ref>
